inputs: same complete retained molecules as previous 81-run matrix; all parameters and validators unchanged
serial_protocol: count_workers=1,pipeline_threads=1; no overlapping graph pipeline stages; MSA direct sequential map with no Python process pool
three_worker_protocol: count_workers=3,pipeline_threads=3; MSA workers=3; primary worker counts matched, not a strict three-core limit
timing: start through native reconstruction, format validation, reference-free conflict rejection and sorted output writing; reference truth scoring and outer decoding follow the timer
cpu: time(1) user+system plus calling-harness self CPU over the same interval; getrusage stage times include graph threads or completed MSA worker/child usage
threading: numerical library parallelism capped at one; MUSCLE3 calls single-threaded
order: all measured jobs serial; cyclic method order and alternating resource-setting order within each dataset/repeat; no previous timings reused
reference_evaluation: same design scoring as original; original outputs used only after timing to check scheduler invariance
